methods.MT.AEENTPT: If AEENRTPT is populated, AEENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.
methods.MT.CMENTPT: If CMENRTPT is populated, CMENTPT is DM.RFPENDTC for the subject.
methods.MT.DAYCALC: Study day relative to RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC + 1 if on or after RFSTDTC. Date - RFSTDTC if date precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.DISEQ: Starts at "1" for first device identifier and increments by one for each DIPARM
methods.MT.DTHFL: If DTHDTC is populated then DTHFL='Y'
methods.MT.EPOCH: EPOCH from SE where date >= SESTDTC and date < SEENDTC
methods.MT.EXDOSE: EXDOSE = ECDOSE * ECPSTRG expressed in mg.
methods.MT.FTSTRESN: If FTSTRESC is numeric then FTSTRESN=FTSTRESC in numeric format, else null.
methods.MT.IEORRES: If IECAT=INCLUSION then IEORRES=N, else if IECAT=EXCLUSION then IEORRES=Y
methods.MT.LBSTRESC: LBSTRESC is equal to LBORRES or the value in standard units if a conversion is necessary.
methods.MT.LOBXFL: Set to "Y" for last record with non-null original result on or before the first dose date (RFXSTDTC). Null otherwise.
methods.MT.QSSTRESC_PH: If QSORRES="Not at all" then 0 If QSORRES="Several days" then 1 If QSORRES="More than half the days" then 2 If QSORRES="Nearly every day" then 3
methods.MT.QSSTRESC_SL: If QSORRES="Strongly disagree" then 1 If QSORRES="Disagree" then 2 If QSORRES="Slightly disagree" then 3 If QSORRES="Neither agree nor disagree" then 4 If QSORRES="Slightly agree" then 5 If QSORRES="Agree" then 6 If QSORRES="Strongly agree" then 7
methods.MT.QSSTRESN: If QSSTRESC is numeric then QSSTRESN=QSSTRESC in numeric format, else null.
methods.MT.RFENDTC: The Date of Study Completion or Early Termination. Null for screen failures.
methods.MT.RFPENDTC: The latest date of assessment for the subject as determined by the End of Study Form, any scheduled assessments, Adverse Events, or Concomitant Medications.
methods.MT.RFSTDTC: The first date/time of study drug. Null for screen failures.
methods.MT.RFXENDTC: The last date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.
methods.MT.RFXSTDTC: The first date/time of study drug administration. Null for subjects with no treatment data.
methods.MT.RSSTRESC: RSSTRESC is the corresponding numeric value of RSORRES according the values shown on the HAMD-17 CRF page.
methods.MT.SEENDTC: SEENDTC is set to the start of the next Element, or RFPENDTC for the last Element.
methods.MT.SEQ: Unique sequence number within a subject, restarting at 1 for every subject, applied to sorted data.
methods.MT.SESTDTC: SESTDTC if set to the --DTC for that subject which exists in the data for the defined start of the Element, such as DSSTDTC when DSDECOD=INFORMED CONSENT OBTAINED for Screening Elements or min(EXSTDTC) for Dosing Elements.
methods.MT.STRESN: If --STRESC represents a numeric value then --STRESN is the numeric version of --STRESC, else null. "--" represents the domain code.
methods.MT.SVENDTC: For each scheduled visit, SVENDTC = the last (max) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVENDTC is the date of the visit.
methods.MT.SVSTDTC: For each scheduled visit, SVSTDTC = the first (min) date associated with a subject for that visit. For unplanned visits, SVSTDTC is the date of the visit.
methods.MT.TSSEQ: Unique sequence number within each TSPARM, restarting at 1 for per TSPARM, applied to sorted data.
methods.MT.VSSTRESC: Data collected in conventional units (i.e. F, lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (C, kg, cm).
